act.long_title: An Act to consolidate and to provide for general rules and principles of evidence for fair trial.

section.heading: Proof of signature and handwriting of person alleged to have signed or written document produced
section.html: If a document is alleged to be signed or to have been written wholly or in part by any person, the signature or the handwriting of so much of the document as is alleged to be in that person's handwriting must be proved to be in his handwriting.
section.text: If a document is alleged to be signed or to have been written wholly or in part by any person, the signature or the handwriting of so much of the document as is alleged to be in that person's handwriting must be proved to be in his handwriting.
